description: Run a five-question AI opportunity interview or turn supplied answers into one evidence-grounded recommendation. Reuse answered questions. Returns report content and host rendering

input.description: Only the current assessment request, relevant business and role context, Mini 1-5 answers in the respondent’s words, and supplied constraints and speaker labels. Send only information needed for this assessment. Omit unrelated content and sensitive personal identifiers. STATIC HOST METADATA host_review: Before rendering, independently compare every claim against the current user's supplied evidence. Quotes must be verbatim and attributed. Preserve manual constraints only when supplied; never infer that checking or sending exists. Remove known goals and tasks from Unknowns. Separate facts, hypotheses and unknowns. Estimates are not measured baselines or savings. Exactly one conditional recommendation; validate prerequisites and obtain the owner's decision before a trial. Measure the same task scope, units and workload before and during a trial. If an essential gap remains, ask one focused question. Never claim files exist until generated; if file tools are unavailable, return the report in chat. Keep corrections outside the customer report. action.description: A question only about what this tool can do returns about with the fixed capability message. Then refuse unsupported external actions/fabrication. Otherwise an explicit report request always returns report even when facts are Unknown. Ask questions only during an interview without a report request. Explicit Unknown counts as supplied. Without an explicit report request, Mini 4 needs both effort and performer. Role=owner is not performer evidence. If only effort is supplied, ask Who does that task? even with the other four answers.
